description: A closed tank 0.6 x 0.6 m (dx 1 cm) with a plate through the free surface (S 10, x 0.273-0.327 m, z 0.153-0.45 m, open below, the air free above); the surface starts tilted (F 57) and the water sloshes under the plate. Two refined levels on the interface band alone (G 1 2, G 24 1.0, no G 25), so the patches of both levels are rebuilt as the surface moves and their edges meet the plate. Around step 212 all patches of a regrid are new: before the patch a new patch had no acceleration term (maxF, maxG, maxH) in its first time step criterion, the step doubled and the air at the plate reached 3.6 m/s (0.17 m/s before and after).
covers: cfd_amr::timestep: the acceleration terms of a patch made at a regrid (ts_acc)
